fusions.name: Preen-Gland Stroke
fusions.desc: A weapon strike slicked with tail-gland oil that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Slick Underfoot
fusions.desc: Sprays oily musk across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Oilskin
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Rolls Off, Sticks On
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.
